title: Pin Art
description: Twenty thousand steel pins in a clear acrylic frame, with John Lennon pressed into them in relief under a raking light. Press from behind to push a hand print out of the steel, and tilt the toy to let the pins clatter back flat.
intent: One physical toy finished to the edge: real pins that slide with friction, stay where you push them, cast long shadows across each other, and only let go when gravity asks.
